newsitem.title: UK: BRITISH GRAND NATIONAL ABANDONED AFTER BOMB CALLS.
newsitem.headline: BRITISH GRAND NATIONAL ABANDONED AFTER BOMB CALLS.

text.p: The Grand National steeplechase, one of Britain's leading horse races, had to be abandoned on Saturday after police received two coded bomb warnings.
Officials told reporters there would be no more racing at the course on Saturday. The warnings prompted a complete evacuation of the racecourse.
The crowd of some 60,000 were ordered off the race course after the bomb warnings, which came some 30 minutes before the start of the big race.

The security alert at one of the most famous steeplechases in the world followed the discovery of two Irish Republican Army bombs on motorways in central England this week which caused massive travel disruption.
